entries.title: Customer order tracking page
entries.need: The SMS tracking link pointed to a page that did not exist, so customers kept calling.
entries.now: Customers open the link, type their mobile number and see the steps, courier, tracking ID, cash to pay and items.
entries.where: Customer page /track?id=<order number> (SMS link, thank-you page, order page › Track)
try: Open any order sent to the courier
Press Track
Type the order's mobile number
See the steps and courier scans

entries.title: Online return requests with pickup
entries.need: Online returns were done like counter returns, with no pickup, checking or replacement shipment.
entries.now: A return is asked, approved, picked up, checked, then refunded or the same items are sent again as a new order.
entries.where: Orders › Return requests (/return-requests); order page › Return; customer page /track
try: Open a delivered order and press Return
Open Orders › Return requests
Approve, book the pickup, mark received
Refund or Send again

entries.title: Order source on Create order
entries.need: Hand-made orders all looked the same, so nobody knew which came from Facebook, WhatsApp or phone.
entries.now: Create order asks where the order came from, and All orders can be filtered by source.
entries.where: Orders › Create order (/new-order); All orders › Search and filter › Source; app New order
try: Create an order with source WhatsApp
Open All orders and press Search
Pick Source: WhatsApp

entries.title: District and area address picker
entries.need: The address was one free box, so customers picked the wrong zone and paid the wrong delivery charge.
entries.now: District then area is chosen from all 64 districts; the area sets the delivery zone and charge.
entries.where: Create order customer card, order link page, store checkout
try: Open the store checkout
Choose Dhaka, then Savar
See Sub-Dhaka chosen and its charge

entries.title: Assign orders to staff
entries.need: Big shops could not split confirming and packing between staff.
entries.now: Each order can be given to a staff member, in bulk too, and each person has an Assigned to me view.
entries.where: Orders › All orders (select › Assign, Assigned to me tab); order page › Assigned to
try: Tick two orders and press Assign
Choose yourself
Open the Assigned to me tab

entries.title: Courier handover with signed manifest
entries.need: There was no proof of which parcels the rider took when cash on delivery went missing.
entries.now: Staff scan each courier's parcels, check count and cash, print a manifest to sign and mark them handed over.
try: Open Courier handover
Choose Pathao and tick its parcels
Print manifest
Press Mark handed over

entries.title: Send licence keys and download links
entries.need: Mark as sent on a digital order sent nothing and the key was not shown anywhere.
entries.now: Sending gives each licence its key and each download its link, messages the customer, and shows them with Resend.
entries.where: Order page of a digital order (Send the download or key card, then Download and keys)
try: Create an approved order for the security licence (no delivery charge is added)
Open it and press Mark as sent
Press Show to see the key, then Resend

entries.title: Checkout settings and order status page
entries.need: The store checkout could not be set up at all.
entries.now: Settings choose guest or sign-in, a code check, email, area, note, terms box, cash fee and limit, smallest order.
entries.where: Settings › Business setup › Checkout (/set-checkout); store /checkout; thank-you › Track your order
try: Open Settings › Checkout
Add a ৳20 cash fee and require email
Open the store checkout and see both
entries.left: Customer accounts with saved addresses need a server; the sign-in code is shown on screen in the demo.

entries.title: Delivery and advance settings now apply
entries.need: Changing delivery charges or the advance percentage in Settings changed nothing on orders.
entries.now: Create order, order links, checkout, app, reports, demo orders and the shipping page use the saved charges and advance.
try: Set Inside Dhaka to ৳80 in Delivery
Create an order inside Dhaka
See ৳80 delivery

entries.title: Customer name opens the customer
entries.need: There was no way from an order to the customer's history, dues and restrictions.
entries.now: The customer's name on the order page opens their profile.
try: Open any order
Press the customer's name

entries.title: Status badges match the tabs
entries.need: The On hold tab showed Pending badges and Processing showed Approved or Ready for courier.
entries.now: Badges use the tab's word, with the step (Approved, Ready for courier) in small grey text beside it.
entries.where: Orders › All orders; order page header; app Orders and order page
try: Open the Processing tab
See Processing badges with the step beside them

entries.title: Return only after delivery
entries.need: Return and Resend receipt showed on orders not delivered or paid yet.
entries.now: Return shows after delivery, Resend receipt once paid or delivered, and Cancel order before that.
try: Open an On hold order and see Cancel order
Open a delivered order and see Return

entries.title: Invoices new sale without POS
entries.need: In the Online edition, New sale on Invoices opened the POS register the shop does not have.
entries.now: Without POS the button says Create order and opens Create order.
try: Open Invoices with the Online edition
Press Create order

entries.title: Create order loads without error
entries.need: Create order showed a page error on every load.
entries.now: Already fixed before this stage; no change needed.
try: Open Create order
Check the console is clean
